newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: CANTV workers to strike Thursday if no pay deal.
newsitem.headline: CANTV workers to strike Thursday if no pay deal.

text.p: Workers at Venezuelan national telephone company CANTV will begin an indefinite strike on Thursday if a pay deal is not reached with management by then, union leaders told Reuters.
Last week, the strike was set for Tuesday, but the date was changed after the Ministry of Labor recognized workers' right to strike 120 hours after they filed a petition to do so.
Workers and management have just re-started talks at the Labor Ministry to try and break the impasse.
If the talks fail "we've decided to strike Thursday, from 0700 local time", said Cruz Hernandez, president of the umbrella telecommunications labor group Fetratel.
Labor is holding out for a 156 percent increase, and has already rejected six wage proposals.
